## OUR HISTORY

Ο Ethnikos Proodeutikos Silogos Neou Keramidiou Pierias it is a Greek football club based in Neo Keramidi, Pieria.

Founded in 1951, its official colours are blue, white and grey. The natural home ground of Ethnikos is the Neos Keramididi Municipal Stadium. During the 2024–2025 season, it competed in the second-tier championship of the A2 National Category (Super League 2), under the name «Ethnikos Progressive Association of Neos Keramidis Pieria Football Club» and with the distinctive title «neo fc».

History
Ethnikos Neo Keramidio participated in a national division for the first time in the 2020-21 season, finishing in 3rd place with 25 points, although they had only played the first round of matches. The following season (2021-22), Ethnikos's campaign was unsatisfactory as they avoided relegation by just a single point.

On 29 August 2021, Ethnikos played their first match in the Greek Cup against Edessaikos, by whom they were defeated 2-0.

In the following seasons in Gamma Ethniki, Ethnikos established itself in the top positions of the league table with a competitive squad. In February 2023, the former international footballer and former manager of Apollon Larissa and P.O. Elassona, Vangelis Moras, was appointed as head coach.

The 2023-24 season is the most golden in the team's history because it won the Gamma Ethniki championship in the 2nd group and promotion to the professional divisions. At the same time, during that period, it also won the Pieria Football Clubs Association Cup, thus achieving its first double.
